name: gitgud-fx
label: Git Gud
description: Title, chapter, infographic card and animated diagrams in Git Gud's dark neon theme: near-black panels, hot pink accent, lane colors from the commit graph.
author: Joseph Lloyd

templates.name: GitGudTitle
templates.label: Git Gud title
templates.description: Full-frame title card with the burning-branch logo drawing itself in, fires flickering.

fields.default: A Git client that runs anywhere you do

templates.name: GitGudChapter
templates.label: Git Gud chapter
templates.description: Chapter label with a pink number badge that slides in at the bottom left over footage.

templates.name: GitGudCard
templates.label: Git Gud card
templates.description: Full-frame infographic: a heading and items that enter one after another, as a list, a grid of up to 12 tiles, or numbered steps on a git-graph rail.

fields.description: Small pink line above the title. Empty hides it.

fields.default:
GitCommit | Commit | Stage lines, write a message, done
GitBranch | Branch | Create, switch and delete from the graph
CloudUpload | Push | Send your commits to origin
LifeBuoy | Recover | Undo almost anything
fields.description: One item per line: "IconName | Label | detail". IconName is a Lucide name such as GitCommit, GitBranch, GitMerge, CloudUpload, Download, Scissors, Swords, LifeBuoy, Eye, Settings, Link, Server, Smartphone, Check, Database, Repeat, Undo2, Pencil, Lock, ShieldCheck, Key, Bell, Timer; unknown names draw a dot.
list: rows (up to about 8). grid: tiles in up to 4 columns (up to 12). steps: numbered steps left to right on a lane rail (up to about 6).
1-based item to emphasize after all items are in; the others dim. 0 = none.

templates.name: GitGudDiagram
templates.label: Git Gud diagram
templates.description: Animated diagrams built up one step per narrated line. focus: family (the four apps), trees (working tree, staging, history), remote (fetch, pull, push), autofix (stash and retry), peers (remote control of another machine), pairing (code and fingerprint), reach (LAN, Tailscale, relay), daemon (gitgud-headless), relay (what the relay can see).

fields.description: Build stage, 1 to 4. Earlier steps show fully built and slightly dimmed; this step's parts animate in and glow. Steps per focus: family 4, trees 3, remote 2, autofix 4, peers 3, pairing 4, reach 3, relay 4, daemon 1; a higher value shows the last step.
Heading at the top left. Empty hides it.
